note: BH-5797: the silence check (bin/lib/silence-scan.sh, rules in catalog/silence-markers.tsv). 1 = a PR whose diff widens a public-leak allow-list (a KNOWN_FAKE_* entry in bin/share, a gitleaks marker) gets the needs-human label and one comment, and no lead review is asked until a person removes the label; every other allow-list line or lint marker goes into the lead review request notes for the Opus lead to judge (no human wait). It reads no extra GitHub data (the compare the self check already fetched). 0 = off: every PR is requested as before, with no marker notes.
